question: Can the already-frozen EfficientLoFTR absolute-support mechanism transport the consumed PV28 reference binding into the full query scene after fixed RoMa produced zero cycles, while rejecting both cross-scene controls?

predecessor.single_change: Replace RoMa cycle transport with frozen EfficientLoFTR target-crop-to-full-scene homography support. Keep PV28 views, reference binding, two target-absent controls, 6-pixel RANSAC tolerance, 8-match/6-inlier absolute-support gate and 0.5 positive extent IoU gate fixed.

matcher.absolute_support: At least eight retained matches, a finite RANSAC homography and at least six inliers.
matcher.adaptation: none; CPU inference; no threshold or score fitting

evaluation.negative_authority: Different physical 3RScan reference families cannot contain exact target PV28.

forbidden_after_freeze: change matcher, processor, crop expansion, views, controls, score, match minimum, inlier minimum, RANSAC tolerance or extent gate
use positive query truth before homography transport
retry, replace or remove a failed pair
combine RoMa and EfficientLoFTR outcomes on this consumed cohort
implementation_correction: The first attempt completed all three matcher calls but failed before serialization because it referenced a nonexistent writer attribute. V2 uses the existing atomic JSON writer; no input, model, match, homography or decision rule changed.
claim_boundary: This is a structurally different, consumed-source Development challenge of target-crop-to-scene local correspondence on one positive and two exact-target-absent controls.
